title: JobPostingCollection
description: Unified schema for collecting raw job posting information from JSearch and Headcount Labs before classification and technical skills extraction.

source_job_id.description: Original job identifier provided by the source API. null if unavailable.

job_title.description: Job title exactly as written in the original posting.

company.description: Company name as provided by the source API.

location.description: City where the job is located, e.g. Riyadh. null if unavailable.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. SA. null if unavailable.

description.description: Full original job description. Preserved for technical skills extraction during the analysis phase.

source.description: API used to collect the job posting.

publisher.description: Original publishing platform or applicant tracking system, e.g. LinkedIn, Workday, Greenhouse, or Lever. null if unknown.

posted_date.description: Original job publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format. null if unavailable. Used to filter postings published in 2026.
